channel.title: Deliver with Flux :: Go Kure
channel.description: Turn a cluster definition into a GitOps repository that Flux reconciles. Read the tutorial first, then the page for the task in front of you. Guides Generating Flux Manifests - The tutorial: define, select the engine, generate, write Flux Layout Rules - Directory and Kustomization names, per-layout settings Umbrella Bundles - Readiness aggregation over child Kustomizations Augmenters and Delivery Intent - Child layouts and per-application prune and force Bootstrapping Flux - Flux system manifests, sync name and source access Concepts Layout and Flux Naming - How directories, files and Flux objects are named OCI Artifact Layout - The directory shape of an OCI artifact and what Kure does to produce it Reference Flux Engine - The engine overview, with the pages below it Flux Names and Paths Flux Layout Integration Flux Bootstrap Generation Flux Umbrella Bundles Flux Non-Bundle Child Layout CRs Flux Defaults Layout Engine - Manifest directory organization
